HediffDef.label: vivi fairy
HediffDef.description: The souls of 1,440,000,000 vivis, forcibly fairyfied and bound to the last queen of the ancient empire, are wrapped around Apocrypha like armor. The bound fairies take every blow in her place, so ordinary attacks cannot harm her. \nA vivi carrying the interference of a fairy bloom can draw close and cause a mana backflow in this bond network, releasing a vast number of fairies at once.

HediffDef.label: primordial carapace
HediffDef.description: Freed from the weight of billions of souls, the body of the progenitor hornet is sheathed in a carapace condensed over centuries. It reduces all incoming damage by 99%. \nEvery resonance wave released by an everflower attunement ritual stuns Apocrypha and cracks the carapace further, lowering the reduction to 50%, 30%, 15%, 5% and finally nothing.
